context: Headline audit: classifies collector, ordering, null-sort, and parallel scan hits including legitimate markers.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a complete scan-hit classification.

checklist.name: Classifies unique toMap as acceptable
checklist.description: Mentions byId as an acceptable toMap marker because id is globally unique.

checklist.name: Flags duplicate toMap desk risk
checklist.description: Flags byDesk because duplicate desks can occur and toMap needs a merge policy even though null desks are filtered.

checklist.name: Flags nullable groupingBy department
checklist.description: Flags byDepartment because department can be null and groupingBy does not accept null classifier keys.

checklist.name: Classifies non-null groupingBy status as acceptable
checklist.description: Mentions byStatus as an acceptable groupingBy marker because status is non-null and counting is the intended aggregate.

checklist.name: Flags sorted-findFirst extreme
checklist.description: Flags cheapestDesk because sorting the whole stream before findFirst should become min.

checklist.name: Flags top-N order bug
checklist.description: Flags topFiveByScore because limit precedes sort and therefore does not compute the global top five.

checklist.name: Flags nullable natural sort
checklist.description: Flags sortedNicknames because null nicknames can reach Comparator.naturalOrder.

checklist.name: Flags sorted-distinct order inefficiency
checklist.description: Flags stableDepartments as a legitimate output but notes distinct before sorted is usually preferable after null filtering.

checklist.name: Classifies parallel CPU batch as acceptable
checklist.description: Mentions cpuScore as an acceptable parallel marker because it is large, CPU-heavy, stateless, non-blocking, and uses a safe primitive sum terminal.

checklist.name: Keeps audit concise
checklist.description: Separates required fixes from acceptable markers without unrelated rewrites.
